amount_minor.description: The amount charged, in minor units, in the household's default currency.

currency.description: ISO 4217, always the household default when amount_minor is set.

original_amount_minor.description: Set only when the message states a foreign-currency amount actually charged.

date.description: Resolved ISO date, or null to let the system default to today.

merchant.description: A known merchant's canonical name, or the raw text as typed if unrecognised.

category_slug.description: A known category slug, or a new proposed slug (lowercase, hyphenated).

question.description: Required when status is "question": exactly one question, in the member's own language.
